# A bench moved out of the photograph

The gallery photographer moved the bench to get a clear view. It stayed against the wall for a week, where a wheelchair user could not sit beside a friend. Put a simple floor mark under the usual feet. [[Exhibition plan]]: a room has a working arrangement as well as a photogenic arrangement, and the latter is not automatically the right default.
